description: Erection of a rear roof extension involving an increase in the ridge height; erection of a rear extension at third floor level over part of the existing back addition; erection of replacement railings around the remaining part of the existing roof terrace at third floor level to the rear elevation; reconstruction of the front roof slope including the erection of a dormer window and installation of 2no rooflights.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawing numbers, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

NKR-R00-PR-103 R01
NKR-R00-PR-104 R01
NKR-R00-PR-106 R01


To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

Roof Front slope - Slate tiles to match existing roof
Roof Rear Extension and Pod - Slate tiles to match existing roof
Dormer front roof - Slate hung tiles to match existing roof with sash upvc window 
Dormer rear roof - Slate tiles to match existing roof with upvc casement window 
Door - French door upvc frame

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.  

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1 and DC4 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 4 - No part of any roof of the rear roof extension and pod hereby approved shall be used as a roof terrace or other form of open amenity space. No alterations shall be carried out; nor planters or other chattels placed on the roofs. No railings or other means of enclosure shall be erected on the roofs, and no alterations shall be carried out to the property to form access onto the roofs.

The use of the roof as a terrace would increase the likelihood of harm to the existing residential amenities of the occupiers of neighbouring properties as a result of overlooking, noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies HO11 and CC11 of the Local Plan (2018).  


Condition : 5 - No water tanks, water tank enclosures or other structures (excluding solar panels and air source heat pumps) shall be erected upon the roofs of the extensions hereby permitted.
												
It is considered that such structures would seriously detract from the appearance of the building, contrary to Policies DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 6 - The roof terrace hereby approved shall not be brought into use until the privacy screening has been installed in accordance with approved drawing no. NKR-R01-PR-104 Rev R01. The privacy screening shall achieve a minimum level of obscurity equivalent to Pilkington Texture Glass Level 3. The privacy screening shall comprise 1.7m-high obscure-glazed screens along the side boundaries of the terrace and a 1.2m-high obscure-glazed screen along the rear boundary of the terrace, measured from the finished floor level of the terrace. The privacy screening shall thereafter be permanently retained and maintained as approved.

To protect the amenities of neighbouring occupiers in terms of overlooking and privacy in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).
